```yaml
name: Release Py

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - "py/**"

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v2

      - name: Run release script
        env:
          PYPI_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PYPI_API_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          ./py/common/release.sh
```
